blocks.text: Good progress to report, and one small thing I would ask of you. Since the search opened, John Chang has built out the market map for the Vice President of Engineering role at {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}}, and James Grant has begun reading the strongest sitting engineering leaders against the specification we agreed. We are describing candidates by their current seat rather than by name at this stage, as we always do while a search is live, and I would ask that Coleman Ltd hold to the same discretion on your side.

The ask is a modest one. So that nothing about this search travels wider than it must, we would like to route every candidate document to you alone, Michael Martin, as the client's single point of contact. If you would rather a second name be copied, tell me and we will set it up straight away.

I will keep this thread moving from our side. As ever, I am your day-to-day contact — Jeffrey Patterson — with James Grant on the senior assessment and John Chang on the research bench. If anything at all is unclear, a short call is easier than a long note, and I am glad to pick up the phone.
